description.value:
You learn to unleash special magical effects with some of your shots. When you gain this feature, you learn two Arcane Shot options of your choice (see "Arcane Shot Options" below).

Once per turn, when you make a ranged weapon attack as part of the Attack action, you can apply one of your Arcane Shot options to that attack. If the attack misses, the use is not expended.

You gain an additional Arcane Shot option of your choice when you reach certain levels in this class: 7th, 10th, 15th, and 18th level.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You can also spend a use of your Second Wind to regain a use of this feature (no action required).
